brief:
An Israeli drone strike on a vehicle in northern Gaza killed a Palestinian man and wounded several others on Friday evening, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported, according to Middle East Eye.

The incident marked the latest in ongoing Israeli military operations in the Gaza Strip. Details on the identity of the deceased and the precise circumstances surrounding the strike were not immediately available.
dek: Israeli drone strike on vehicle kills Palestinian man in northern Gaza A Palestinian man was killed and several others were wounded on Friday evening in an Israeli drone strike on a vehicle in the northern Gaza Strip, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported.
title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian man in northern Gaza
